mapper.select: SELECT M.sectionId, M.id, M.parentId, CASE WHEN M.elmtCclsCd = '7' AND D.INTG_IMG_FILE_PATH_NM IS NOT NULL THEN 'http://hisimg.snuh.org/' || REGEXP_REPLACE(D.INTG_IMG_FILE_PATH_NM, '\\', '/') ELSE M.content END AS content, M."desc" FROM ( SELECT A.MDFM_SCTN_SEQ AS sectionId, A.MDFM_CPEM_ID AS id, A.UPR_MDFM_CPEM_ID AS parentId, CASE WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD IN ('4', '5', '6') THEN B.MDFM_ELMT_INPT_CNTE WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD = '7' THEN 'http://hisimg.snuh.org/' || REGEXP_REPLACE(C.INTG_IMG_FILE_PATH_NM, '\\', '/') WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD = '9' THEN LEFT(COALESCE(B.MDFM_ELMT_INPT_CNTE, C.DCST_LDAT), 10) ELSE COALESCE(B.MDFM_ELMT_INPT_CNTE, C.DCST_LDAT) END AS content, CASE WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD IN ('4', '5', '6') THEN A.MDFM_CPEM_CNTE END AS "desc", A.ELMT_CCLS_CD AS elmtCclsCd, CASE WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD = '7' THEN ( ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.ELMT_CCLS_CD ORDER BY A.MDFM_CPEM_ID) - 1) ELSE -1 END AS imageSeq FROM ODS.S_MRFMFCID A LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRECE B ON B.MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND B.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} AND A.MDFM_CPEM_ID = B.MDFM_CPEM_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRLFE C ON C.MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND C.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} AND A.MDFM_CPEM_ID = C.MDFM_CPEM_ID WHERE A.MDFM_ID = #{mdfmId} AND A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ = #{mdfmFomSeq} AND A.MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD = 'V' ORDER BY A.MDFM_SCTN_SEQ, A.MDFM_CPEM_ID, A.UPR_MDFM_CPEM_ID ) M LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRIMD D ON D.MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND D.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} AND M.imageSeq = D.IMG_SEQ

SELECT M.sectionId, M.id, M.parentId, CASE WHEN M.elmtCclsCd = '7' AND D.INTG_IMG_FILE_PATH_NM IS NOT NULL THEN 'http://hisimg.snuh.org/' || REGEXP_REPLACE(D.INTG_IMG_FILE_PATH_NM, '\\', '/') ELSE M.content END AS content, M."desc" FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.MDFM_SCTN_SEQ AS sectionId, A.MDFM_CPEM_ID AS id, A.UPR_MDFM_CPEM_ID AS parentId, CASE WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD IN ('4', '5', '6') THEN B.MDFM_ELMT_INPT_CNTE WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD = '7' THEN 'http://hisimg.snuh.org/' || REGEXP_REPLACE(C.INTG_IMG_FILE_PATH_NM, '\\', '/') WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD = '9' THEN LEFT(COALESCE(B.MDFM_ELMT_INPT_CNTE, C.DCST_LDAT), 10) ELSE COALESCE(B.MDFM_ELMT_INPT_CNTE, C.DCST_LDAT) END AS content, CASE WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD IN ('4', '5', '6') THEN A.MDFM_CPEM_CNTE END AS "desc", A.ELMT_CCLS_CD AS elmtCclsCd, CASE WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD = '7' THEN ( ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.ELMT_CCLS_CD ORDER BY A.MDFM_CPEM_ID) - 1) ELSE -1 END AS imageSeq FROM ODS.S_MRFMFCID A LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRECE B ON B.MDRC_ID = '45274491' AND B.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = '2' AND A.MDFM_CPEM_ID = B.MDFM_CPEM_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRLFE C ON C.MDRC_ID = '45274491' AND C.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = '2' AND A.MDFM_CPEM_ID = C.MDFM_CPEM_ID WHERE 1=1 AND C.DCST_LDAT IS NOT NULL AND A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ = '2' AND A.MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD = 'V' ORDER BY A.MDFM_SCTN_SEQ, A.MDFM_CPEM_ID, A.UPR_MDFM_CPEM_ID ) M LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRIMD D ON D.MDRC_ID = '45274491' AND D.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = '2' AND M.imageSeq = D.IMG_SEQ

SELECT (CASE WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('13','14') THEN 1 WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('11','12') THEN 2 WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('15','16') THEN 3 WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('17') THEN 4 WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('21') THEN 5 WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('22') THEN 6 WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('23') THEN 7 WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('32') THEN 8 WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('31') THEN 9 WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('33') THEN 10 END) AS id ,(CASE WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('13','14') THEN '수술전진단명' WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('11','12') THEN '수술명' WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('15','16') THEN '수술후진단명' WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('17') THEN '수술기타' WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('21') THEN '수술전기록_예정수술명' WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('22') THEN '수술전기록_수술전진단명' WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('23') THEN '수술전기록_기타' WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('32') THEN '수술후기록_수술후진단명' WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('31') THEN '수술후기록_최종수술명' WHEN A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD IN ('33') THEN '수술후기록_기타' END) AS title ,SORT_SEQ AS sortSeq ,OP_NM_DGNS_NM AS dgndNm ,ANST_KND_NM AS kndNm ,OP_DTM AS opDtm ,(SELECT STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD WHERE STF_NO = TH1_PFDR_STF_NO ) AS pfdr1Nm ,(SELECT STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD WHERE STF_NO = TH2_PFDR_STF_NO ) AS pfdr2Nm ,(SELECT STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD WHERE STF_NO = TH3_PFDR_STF_NO ) AS pfdr3Nm ,(SELECT STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD WHERE STF_NO = TH1_ATDR_STF_NO ) AS atdr1Nm ,(SELECT STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD WHERE STF_NO = TH2_ATDR_STF_NO ) AS atdr2Nm ,(SELECT STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD WHERE STF_NO = TH3_ATDR_STF_NO ) AS atdr3Nm ,(SELECT STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD WHERE STF_NO = TH4_ATDR_STF_NO ) AS atdr4Nm FROM ODS.S_MRDDRONE A WHERE A.MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} ORDER BY id, sortSeq

SELECT MDFM_CLS_CD AS recordId, MDFM_ID AS mdfmId, MDFM_FOM_SEQ AS mdfmFomSeq, MDFM_SCTN_SEQ AS sectionId, MDFM_CPEM_ID AS id, UPR_MDFM_CPEM_ID AS parentId, MDFM_CPEM_NO AS mdfmCpemNo, CASE WHEN MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD = 'E' THEN 'ENTITY' WHEN MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD = 'A' THEN 'ATTRIBUTE' WHEN MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD = 'AV' THEN 'ATTRIBUTE' WHEN MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD = 'V' THEN 'VALUE' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS classType, CASE WHEN ELMT_CCLS_CD = '1' THEN 'LABEL' WHEN ELMT_CCLS_CD = '2' THEN 'TEXT_BOX' WHEN ELMT_CCLS_CD = '3' THEN 'RICH_TEXT_BOX' WHEN ELMT_CCLS_CD = '4' THEN 'COMBO_BOX' WHEN ELMT_CCLS_CD = '5' THEN 'CHECK_BOX' WHEN ELMT_CCLS_CD = '6' THEN 'RADIO_BUTTON' WHEN ELMT_CCLS_CD = '7' THEN 'IMAGE' WHEN ELMT_CCLS_CD = '8' THEN 'NUMERIC_TEXT_BOX' WHEN ELMT_CCLS_CD = '9' THEN 'DATE_TEXT_BOX' WHEN ELMT_CCLS_CD = '12' THEN 'DATA_GRID' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS controlType, NULL as maskingType, ISNULL(MDFM_CPEM_CNTE, ELMT_BSC_CNTE) AS content, ELMT_BSC_CNTE AS "desc", LSH_DTM AS loadDtm FROM ods.S_MRFMFCID WHERE MDFM_CLS_CD IN ('D001', 'D002', 'D003', 'D004', 'D005', 'D006', 'D007', 'D008', 'D009', 'D010', 'D011', 'D020', 'D030', 'D031', 'D035')
AND LSH_DTM::DATE >= #{startDate}::DATE AND LSH_DTM::DATE < #{endDate}::DATE
ORDER BY MDFM_CLS_CD, MDFM_ID, MDFM_FOM_SEQ, MDFM_SCTN_SEQ, MDFM_CPEM_ID, UPR_MDFM_CPEM_ID

SELECT 'DR' AS recordType, A.MDFM_CLS_CD AS recordDetailType, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'RDO062' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.MDFM_CLS_DTL_CD) AS itemType, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'RDO062' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.MDFM_CLS_DTL_CD) AS itemNm, A.MDF_REC_DTM::DATE AS writingDate, A.WRTR_DEPT_CD AS writingDeptCd, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.WRTR_DEPT_CD) AS writingDeptNm, A.WRT_STF_NO AS writerStfNo, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.WRT_STF_NO) AS writerNm, NULL AS keyId, A.PACT_ID AS pactId, A.PACT_TP_CD AS pactTpCd, DECODE(A.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpNm, A.PT_MED_DEPT_CD AS ptMedDeptCd, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.PT_MED_DEPT_CD) AS ptMedDeptNm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_CHAR(A.MDF_REC_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY A.REC_DTM DESC) AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, A.MDFM_ID AS mdfmId, A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ AS mdfmFomSeq, A.MDRC_ID AS mdrcId, A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ AS mdrcFomSeq, NULL AS examKey, NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd, NULL AS accsId, NULL AS recType, NULL AS geneExmYn, CASE WHEN A.MDRC_WRT_STS_CD > 10 THEN 'Y' END AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MRDDRECM A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRCNE B ON B.MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND B.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} AND A.MDRC_ID = B.ODRPY_MDRC_ID AND A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = B.ODRPY_MDRC_FOM_SEQ WHERE A.MDFM_CLS_CD = 'D008' AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' AND A.MDRC_DC_TP_CD = 'C' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.WRT_STF_NO AND Z.OCTY_TP_CD = 'Z06')
